description:
More Power for Every Ride
With 1000W max power, enjoy responsive acceleration and extra power for daily commutes and uphill rides.

Go Further on Every Charge
Travel up to 28 miles on a single charge, giving you more freedom for work commutes, errands, and weekend adventures.

Pick Up the Pace
Reach speeds of up to 25 MPH, making longer commutes quicker and more efficient.

Smoother Rides Over Everyday Bumps
8.5-inch pneumatic tires help absorb road vibrations and provide a more comfortable ride on city streets and uneven pavement.

Take on Steeper Hills
With a rated 35° climbing capability, tackle challenging inclines and hilly routes with greater confidence.
